garbaanddandiyaraa.note: Most garba songs are old folk and devotional songs with no single author, sung anew by each generation, so the same title turns up in many versions. Non-stop medley albums are how the music is mostly sold and played.

The performance tradition of Ukrainian folk musicians of 18th – the beginning of 20th centuries. Kobza, lira, torban, bandura.
kobzardumy.note: Starts with modern kobzar-revival recordings, then goes back to the 1908–1910 wax cylinders of the last traditional kobzari and lirnyky, which are crackly but real. Titles are printed as their sources print them, in English or in Latin-letter Ukrainian.
